text: DSH Workload Report 是面向 Web 客户端的工作量统计插件。它在侧边栏加入工作量看板，并通过宿主只读接口汇总 DSH 会话投影数据。用户可以按日期、工作区和模型查看活跃时间与 Token 用量，也可查看模型表现、同步多台设备的统计行，并生成独立 HTML 报告。适合希望回顾个人或团队 DSH 使用情况的人。默认统计保存在本机；多设备同步与 AI 画像为可选功能。

DSH Workload Report adds a sidebar dashboard to the DSH web client. It summarizes session activity and token usage by date, workspace, and model, and can sync summary rows across devices or generate an HTML report. Statistics stay local by default; sync and AI profiling are optional.
我想按日期和项目查看 DSH 花了多少时间、用了多少 Token。
能不能把多个设备上的 DSH 工作量汇总到一个看板里？
I want a dashboard that breaks down my DSH token usage and active time by workspace.
DSH Workload Report 的功能「工作量看板」：在侧边栏打开统计面板，按日期、工作区和模型浏览会话活跃时间、Token 用量等聚合指标。面板从宿主只读接口获取统计快照。
DSH Workload Report 的功能「多设备统计同步」：启用并配置后，可通过 COS、GitHub、Gitea 或共享目录推送、拉取每台设备的会话统计行，并在看板中合并展示。
DSH Workload Report 使用前须知：启用同步后，会向所选 COS、GitHub、Gitea 或共享目录传送会话统计行；默认关闭。GitHub/Gitea 与 COS 需配置令牌或密钥。
DSH Workload Report 使用前须知：AI 用户画像仅在用户点击生成后才调用 DSH 的 llm 服务，并发送聚合统计白名单；浏览面板或探测状态不会调用模型。

dsh-workload-report README · What it is：DSH shows stats for the **current session**. This plugin adds the cross-session, cross-project, cross-time view: which dates and which workspaces your effort went to, which hours you were productive, which models consumed the tokens, and what it cost — plus a static report for clients, teammates or monthly reviews.

dsh-workload-report README · What it is：**Not only cost, but the work behind it.** Active time, active days and turns show what you actually did; tokens and estimated cost show what it consumed. Numbers use the same definitions everywhere, so the dashboard and the exported report agree.

Model and hourly-token dimensions use the official `sessionQuery.readSession()` event log.
- **No storage-format parsing.** The plugin never opens `*.jsonl.zstd`, never parses zstd/JSONL, and never reads the harness's internal projection-cache files. Formats can change between releases; the official seams are the contract.
- **Zero outbound requests by default.** All statistics stay on your machine. The plugin exposes read-only HTTP routes only, and writes only its own local index at `<DSH_HOME>/workload-report/index-v7.json` plus the AI-profile cache in the same directory (both safe to delete; they rebuild). The AI profile calls a model only after you click Generate.

- **Model token share**: a compact donut on the dashboard; full model details live in the next tab.
- **Model usage tab**: treemap (area = token share, Top 8 + others), stacked daily trend (Top 6 models), a detail table (**speed tok/s /

dsh-workload-report README · What's new in 2.4.0：- **Correct device filtering**: select a device and every chart shows only that device (local included), not just the calendar.
- **Pulled data survives restarts**: the last pull is cached to disk, so other devices stay visible after a restart or offline.
- **Auto fallback**: a device that disappears from the sync sources is dropped from the filter (back to "all devices" if none remain).

**By workspace**: three bars — sessions / turns · my effort · token spend, one shared scale
dsh-workload-report README · Metric definitions：The full definitions live in **[docs/metrics.md](./docs/metrics.md)**. Durations use one language-neutral `H / M / S` format (like K/M/B for tokens).

dsh-workload-report README · Metric definitions：- **Active time** = model time + tool time − waiting for user. It is **cumulative engine work**, not wall-clock time (concurrent sessions and subagents each add up). Waiting for user is tracked separately as `waitMs`.
- **Time of day** defaults to **token output** (switchable to **turns**), with human-message density dots on top. Sessions with unreadable event logs are excluded from the token chart and counted in the card.
- **Total tokens** = uncached input + output + cache read + cache write. **Conversations** = sessions with at least one step. **Attribution date** = the session's creation day in the selected time zone.
- **Model cost** is estimated from built-in official public prices; only models with an official price get a number, others show **—** (an estimate, never an invoice).
- **Output speed tok/s** = weighted `ΣdecodeTokens / (ΣdecodeMs / 1000)`, excluding time to first token. **TTFT** = `step/start → first token`.
- **Ranges**: the end is always today and the start is `max(window start, first active day)`, so the active-days denominator is always the real span. The calendar heatmap always covers full history.

dsh-workload-report README · Version：- The version comes from `package.json` via the host (`/sync`); it is never hard-coded in the client and is not rendered when unavailable.
- The build hash identifies *which build the page is running*: if it stays old after an upgrade, the browser cached the
  client bundle (restart DSH / hard refresh) — it does **not** mean the version bump was forgotten.
- It is plain selectable text, so you can paste that line in a bug report.
- Release-time check: `node test/check-release.mjs --tag vX.Y.Z` compares `package.json`, CHANGELOG and both READMEs
  and validates the tag; it runs in CI.

- **Responsive report width**: full width on narrow screens, capped at 1450px on wide ones, with viewport-scaled

dsh-workload-report README · AI user profile：**Included by default, but only generated by a manual click; opening the panel never calls a model.** The profile lives on its own top-level tab, aligned to the **right end of the navigation** and tinted so it stands out from the other tabs; the Top sessions tab keeps the sessions table alone.

dsh-workload-report README · AI user profile：- **First-open notice**: before any result, a three-line panel explains that only the last N days of aggregates are sent (no conversation text / titles / paths), which provider/model will be used (host default when unknown), and that the model is called — and costs may apply — only after clicking **Generate profile**. The notice disappears once a result exists; the result card offers **Regenerate**.
- **Trigger**: opening the panel only runs a `probe` (no model call; `llm.prepareCall` stays at 0). The model is called when you click **Generate profile / Regenerate**; the button is disabled while generating.

- **What is sent**: a strict whitelist of 56 aggregate fields — range, net active / wait time, sessions and turns, the four token components and their shares, cache-hit rate, average session / turns / steps, four session-duration buckets, 24 hourly token buckets, five time bands (active
dsh-workload-report README · AI user profile：Full details: [docs/ai-profile.md](./docs/ai-profile.md).

dsh-workload-report README · Read-only API：| Route | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `GET {apiPath}/snapshot?days=30&tz=Asia/Shanghai&scope=all` | Aggregated snapshot JSON (totals / byDay / byWorkspace / byHour / bySession / calendar / byModel / modelDaily / diagnostics) |
| `GET {apiPath}/export.json?...` | Same payload with a `content-disposition` header |
| `GET {apiPath}/report.html?days=90&theme=dark&anonymize=1&title=...` | Self-contained HTML report |
| `GET {apiPath}/profile?days=30&tz=...&lang=zh&probe=1` | AI user profile: `probe=1` only reports enabled / signed-in / model, never calls one; otherwise generates on demand; `days` is floored at `aiProfile.minDays` (30); `force=1` bypasses the fingerprint cache |
| `GET {apiPath}/profile?...&provider=...&model=...` | **Debug entry**: override the route for this request only (only when enabled; no config write, no cache write) |
| `GET {apiPath}/health` | Index diagnostics (sessions, checkpoint hits, cold reads, read failures, duration); `diagnostics.aiProfile` has the latest profile code / stage / error / route |
| `GET {apiPath}/balance` | Cached balance state for the toolbar chip; never touches the index |
dsh-workload-report README · Read-only API：Parameters: `from`/`to` (YYYY-MM-DD, take precedence over `days`), `days`, `all=1` (earliest active day → today), `tz` (IANA time zone), `scope`.

dsh-workload-report README · Index & upgrading：- Index file: `<DSH_HOME>/workload-report/index-v7.json`; `INDEX_VERSION = 7`.
- Upgrading from 0.6.5 or earlier **rebuilds the index and re-folds event data on first launch** (the hour buckets and hourly token/human-message fields are versioned). The API returns progressively filled data with `indexing: true` while this runs.
- Deleting the index is safe: the plugin cold-reads historical sessions again. Cold reads use official interfaces and concurrency 8 (about 2 minutes for 300+ sessions on the author's machine).
- Very early **v0-format sessions** may not be readable at all. They are excluded from statistics and the UI reports how many; the time-of-day card shows **“Token 未计入 N 个会话”** when their token distribution cannot be read.

dsh-workload-report README · Privacy：All statistics stay on your machine. The plugin registers **read-only** HTTP routes only: by default no outbound requests, no telemetry, no user content collected. It writes only its own index cache plus the optional AI-profile cache; nothing else in your harness data is touched. The exported report may contain session titles unless you pass `anonymize=1`.

dsh-workload-report README · Privacy：**Optional balance chip — off by default.** Only when you set `balance.enabled: true` does the host call the official `deepseekAccount` service: `getBalance()` makes the **host** request `https://platform.deepseek.com/api/v0/users/get_user_summary` (the account balance endpoint). It is opt-in and cached for `balance.refreshMs`. The top-up/usage links come from the service's local `getState()` and need no network. A failed or timed-out query shows an em dash with a top-up link — never an error dialog. The balance is rendered only in your own toolbar chip and is **never written into the exported HTML report**.

dsh-workload-report README · Privacy：**AI user profile — included by default, manual trigger only.** Opening the panel / `probe` only reads enabled, sign-in state, and provider/model; it **never calls a model**. Only after you click **Generate profile** does the plugin call the `llm` service (and your configured model provider) with the aggregate whitelist described in [AI user profile](#ai-user-profile), always using a window of at least 30 days. No conversation text, titles, paths, session ids, or event logs are sent. The response is cached on disk in the plugin's own directory; the static HTML report never contains it. If the service is missing, you are not signed in, the call times out, or parsing fails, the card falls back to local rules and shows the reason — no error dialog. This side call is not included in the plugin's token / cost report. Set `aiProfile.enabled: false` to hide the entry and guarantee zero model calls.

dsh-workload-report README · Compatibility：- DSH `0.2.x`, **including `alpha` prereleases** (developed and verified against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2`). The plugin depends only on official interfaces (`sessionProjections` / `sessionProjectionCache` / `sessionQuery`) and Node built-ins, never on internal file formats.
- The first launch cold-reads historical sessions whose projection checkpoints are missing; the API returns progressively filled data with `indexing: true`, and restarts reuse the persisted index.
- Very early **v0-format sessions** may not be migratable/readable by the current harness. They are excluded from statistics and the UI reports how many.

dsh-workload-report README · 数据来源与原则：- **只用官方接口。** 会话身份来自 `sessionQuery.listSessions()`；统计来自官方投影（`sessionProjections`、`sessionProjectionCache`），必要时用官方 `sessionQuery.observeSession()` 冷读兜底；模型与小时 Token 维度使用官方 `sessionQuery.readSession()` 事件日志。
- **不解析存储格式。** 插件从不打开 `*.jsonl.zstd`，不解析 zstd / JSONL，也不读 Harness 内部的投影缓存文件。格式会随版本演进，官方接口才是稳定契约。
- **默认零外发网络请求。** 统计数据全部留在本机；插件只注册只读 HTTP 路由，只写自己的本地索引 `<DSH_HOME>/workload-report/index-v7.json`；AI 画像只在你点击生成时旁路调用模型，并把缓存写到同目录（两者删掉都会自动重建）。
- **需要外发网络的场景**：可选余额 chip（`balance.enabled: true`，默认关闭，由**宿主**调用官方 `deepseekAccount` 服务），以及 **AI 用户画像**（默认包含，但只有点击「生成画像」才调用模型；只把聚合统计发给已配置的模型）。见「隐私」。
- **不编数字。** 读不出的早期会话会被排除并在界面写明数量；没有官方价的模型在费用列显示 **—**，不猜。

dsh-workload-report README · 口径说明：- **活跃时长** = 模型时间 + 工具时间 − 等待用户，是**引擎累计工作时间**，不是墙钟时长（并发会话与子代理各自累加）；等待用户单列为 `waitMs`。
- **时刻分析** 默认 **Token 产出**（可切 **轮次**），顶部叠人类消息密度点；读不出事件日志的会话不计入 Token 图，并在卡片注明数量。
- **总 Token** = 未命中输入 + 输出 + 缓存读 + 缓存写。**对话次数** = 至少产生 1 个 step 的会话数。**归属日期** = 会话创建时间在所选时区的自然日。
- **模型费用** 按内置官方公开价估算；只有有官方价的模型才给数字，无价显示 **—**（是估算，不是账单）。
- **输出速度 tok/s** = 加权 `ΣdecodeTokens / (ΣdecodeMs / 1000)`，不含等首字；**首字延迟（TTFT）** = `step/start → 首个 token`。
- **统计区间**：终点恒为今天，起点 = `max(窗口起点, 最早活跃日)`，所以活跃天数的分母永远是真实跨度；日历热力图固定展示全部历史。

dsh-workload-report README · AI 用户画像：- **首开提示**：尚无结果时显示三行提示——只发送近 N 天聚合统计（不含对话正文 / 标题 / 路径）、使用哪个 provider/model（未知显示宿主默认）、点击后才调用模型并产生费用；面板内是「生成画像」主按钮。生成后提示面板消失，显示结果，右上提供「重新生成」。
- **触发**：打开面板只做 `probe`（不调用模型，`llm.prepareCall` 次数为 0）；点「生成画像 / 重新生成」才真正请求，生成中按钮禁用。
- **汇总窗口**：固定使用 `max(当前区间, aiProfile.minDays)` 的聚合数据，`minDays` 默认 **30**；即使看板选近 7 天，画像请求的 `days` 也 `>= 30`。结果卡片标注「基于近 N 天汇总」，N 来自实际聚合窗口。
- **发送什么**：严格白名单的 56 个聚合字段——区间、净活跃 / 等待、会话与轮次、Token 四分量与占比、
  缓存命中率、平均会话 / 轮次 / 步骤、会话时长四桶、24 小时 Token 桶、5 个时段（活跃 + Token 占比）、
  工作区前 5、模型前 5、工作区数 / 切换次数、模型数 / 多模型、周末 / 夜间占比、近 7 天 vs 前 7 天趋势。
  **绝不发送**对话正文、会话标题、cwd / 路径、会话 id 或事件日志；宿主会断言键集合严格等于白名单，
  并递归拒绝私有键与路径字符串。
- **Prompt**：资深生产力分析师；每条结论**必须引用数字**，禁止空泛建议；只输出严格 JSON
  （headline / dimensions / advice / risk），temperature 0.35、**不传 maxTokens**。
- **解析 / 截断抢救**：干净 JSON → 代码围栏 → 前后夹文字时宽松提取；若 `finish.kind=length`
  或文本明显未收尾，先补齐未闭合的字符串 / 数组 / 对象括号再解析，成功则标记 `truncated: true`
  （卡片底部提示「输出被截断，已修复采用」）；修不好才降级，原始输出前 300 字进 `diagnostic.excerpt`。
- **缓存**：白名单稳定 JSON 的 SHA-256 前 16 位（新增字段自动参与）；结果与索引同目录原子落盘
  （`.tmp` → `rename`，`PROFILE_CACHE_VERSION = 4`）。指纹相同直接返回缓存，不再调用模型；`force=1` 重新生成。
- **失败降级**：llm 缺失、未登录 / 无模型、超时、非 `stop` 结束、空输出、JSON 解析失败——
  一律返回

dsh-workload-report README · 隐私：统计数据全部留在本机；插件只注册**只读** HTTP 路由，**默认不联网**、不采集任何用户内容。只写自己的索引缓存（以及可选的画像缓存），不改动任何 Harness 数据。导出的 HTML 报告默认包含会话标题，可用 `anonymize=1` 隐藏。

**可选余额 chip —— 默认关闭。** 只有显式设置 `balance.enabled: true` 后，宿主才会调用官方 `deepseekAccount` 服务：`getBalance()` 会让**宿主**请求 `https://platform.deepseek.com/api/v0/users/get_user_summary`（账户余额接口）。默认关闭、按 `balance.refreshMs` 缓存；充值 / 用量链接来自服务的本地 `getState()`，不需要网络。查询失败或超时只在 chip 上显示「—」+ 充值链接，不弹错误。余额只渲染在你本机的工具栏 chip 里，**绝不写入**导出的 HTML 报告。

dsh-workload-report README · 隐私：**AI 用户画像 —— 默认包含，但只手动触发。** 打开面板 / `probe` 只读取 enabled、登录状态与 provider/model，**不调用模型**；只有点击「生成画像」后，插件才会调用 `llm` 服务（以及你配置的模型），发送 [AI 用户画像](#ai-用户画像) 中列出的聚合白名单（汇总窗口至少 30 天），不发送对话正文、标题、路径、会话 id 或事件日志。结果缓存在插件自己的目录；静态 HTML 报告不包含画像。llm 缺失、未登录、超时或解析失败时，卡片降级为本地规则版并显示原因，不弹错误框。这次旁路调用不计入本插件的 Token / 费用报表。显式设置 `aiProfile.enabled: false` 时入口隐藏、零模型调用。

dsh-workload-report README · 开发：| 命令 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `pnpm add -D esbuild puppeteer-core` | 安装构建与浏览器测试依赖（也可用 `ESBUILD_PATH` / `WL_PUPPETEER_DIR` 指向已有安装） |
| `node build.mjs` | 用 esbuild 把 `src/client/` 打成 `lib/client.js`（ModuleLoader 工厂格式） |
| `node test/verify.mjs` | **1608 项离线断言**：聚合口径与四档区间同源、时区、轮次落桶与守恒、按消息时间的小时 Token、人类消息密度、等待剔除（三层判定 + 长任务豁免 + `excludeWait:false` 回归）、索引 / 冷读兜底、报告结构对齐、画像独立页签右对齐与 30 天窗口、多设备同步（载荷 / 合并 / 凭据 / 设置 / 设备筛选 / 拉取缓存持久化）、速度与首字延迟口径、首开零模型调用、i18n 逐键对齐、余额状态 |
| `./test/e2e-boot.sh 3299` | 起一个**隔离实例**（独立 DSH_HOME + 端口），不影响正在用的 GUI |
| `node test/e2e-ui.mjs` | 真实浏览器 E2E：日历 / 柱状切换、几何校验、环形图、报告导出、时刻卡 |
dsh-workload-report README · 开发：CI 会跑 `build.mjs` + `verify.mjs`，并校验入库的 `lib/client.js` 与源码一致。

dsh-workload-report README · 兼容性：- DSH `0.2.x`，**含 `alpha` 预发布版**（开发与验证基于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2`）。插件只依赖官方接口（`sessionProjections` / `sessionProjectionCache` / `sessionQuery`）与 Node 内置模块，不碰内部文件格式。
- 首次启动会对投影检查点未命中的历史会话做一次冷读；期间接口返回逐步填充的数据并带 `indexing: true`，结果落盘后重启即复用。
- 极早期的 **v0 格式会话**可能无法被当前 Harness 迁移 / 读取；这类会话不计入统计，界面会写明数量。
